svg.title: The event horizon, photon sphere, and critical curve
svg.desc: The left panel shows a Schwarzschild equatorial slice. A dark disk at radius two M marks the horizon, and a dashed circle at three M marks the photon sphere. The separate right panel shows the critical curve on the impact-parameter screen of an observer at infinity, with radius three times the square root of three M. Inward rays below that impact parameter are captured.

g.aria-label: Critical impact parameter equals three square root of three M
